lines.t: (Atmospheric pads, muffled 4/4 kick fading in)
(Vocal chop: "Lead... Lead the way...")
Lost inside the light, yeah the soul is taking flight,
Caught up in the motion of the Spirit through the night.
No more looking back at the ghost of the past,
I found a foundation that's built to last,
Yeah, it’s built to last.
[Build-up]
(Snare rolls accelerate, bass frequency rises)
I’m rising up, I’m letting go
I’m following the light in the ebb and flow
Higher...
Higher!
[Drop / Chorus]
(Heavy syncopated Garage beat, deep "wobble" bass)
Take my hands, lead the way!
In the dark, You’re the day!
(Vocal chop: "Lead... Lead the way...")
Take my hands, lead the way!
I’m alive, come what may!
UK sound with a heavenly grace
I see the mercy written all on Your face
From the London streets to the clouds above
I’m caught in the wave of a Perfect Love
Yeah, a Perfect Love.
[Bridge]
(Beat drops out, ambient synth only)
One God, one heart, one rhythm.
One God, one heart, one rhythm.
(Beat kicks back in)
Let’s go!
Take my hands, lead the way!
In the dark, You’re the day!
Take my hands, lead the way!
I’m alive, come what may!
[Outro]
(Beat strips back to just the bass and kick)
Lead the way...
